title: Ruins of Saint Paul's
visualBrief: Complete surviving five-tier granite facade with3real open portals/upper lights, bronze saints in deep shell niches, layered paired columns/capitals/entablatures, carved ship/dragon/skeleton/hourglass/angel/scroll relief, triangular dove/sun/star pediment, pin finials/cross and bounded threshold stairs/low rear remnants. No burned church or long public stairway reconstruction. Complete compiled-native thin facade extent; elevation detail and concealed rear supports are photographic estimates.
